sample.limits: Legacy labels are unadjudicated detector outputs. VALID means no issue was identified by that bounded review, not a negative task label.

review_status.unresolved: The other task labels require repository-style claim review. This run otherwise records discovery outputs only.

metric_limits: The sample is development data, the reference set is incomplete, and annotator severity varied. Do not report these rates as SWE-rebench V2 corpus defect prevalence, false-positive rate, or method recall.
